items.title: Istio 1.31 Adds Agentgateway Waypoints and Moves Release Artifacts off Google Cloud
items.blurb: Istio 1.31 adds agentgateway waypoints in ambient mode, with a canary configuration fix included in 1.31.1.

items.title: Kubernetes Teams Get a Safer Way to See Their Own GPU Metrics
items.blurb: Adobe engineers have described an open-source approach for giving teams self-service access to their own Prometheus metrics in multi-tenant Kubernetes environments, without exposing the shared metrics of other teams. By Craig Risi

items.title: Uber Separates Scaling Intent From Execution on Kubernetes Platform
items.blurb: Uber has published a detailed account of its new ServiceScale controller, which allows multiple orchestrators to safely manage the scaling of the same Kubernetes workloads.
